title: ShadowGPT
introBefore: Protect the company from leaks via public AI services: monitoring, risk classification, and policies before sensitive data leaves the perimeter. The product is available at
features: Shadow AI control: visibility into employee prompts to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other services.
Browser extension and cloud dashboard — no server agents or long deployments.
Prompt and attachment analysis locally in the extension: confidential text is not sent to a server for parsing.
Layered risk scoring: regex, custom rules, Presidio NER, LLM — before the request goes to AI.
Files and attachments: PDF, DOCX, code, images with OCR — text extraction on the user device.
Flag / warn / block policies and alerts (Telegram, webhook, email) for high‑risk events.
footer: Shadow AI Protection — policies and audit without a black box around public LLMs
